answer: A bond of 25% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Deposits are visible in lotus, and sonnet reconciles the forfeits at each close. Because the custody account is separate, anyone cannot recycle one pool of capital across 112 aliases, and each one needs its own funded nectar account. The per-identity price is 8 dollars, and it is forfeited outright on the first bad verdict. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
